title: The Score of Students Solving Math Expression
goal: Score student answers to a single-digit addition and multiplication expression.
strategy: Compute the correct precedence result separately. Interval DP enumerates results from alternative parenthesizations; correct answers earn five, other attainable answers earn two, and remaining answers earn zero.
